title: X Tumbleweed
name: x_tumbleweed
short_description: Lively desert tumbleweeds that roll and bounce across dunes in the wind, split into baby tumbleweeds, and drop native desert flora.
long_description:
Bring your arid lands to life with lively, wind-blown tumbleweeds that bounce and roll across vast desert sands, leap over rocky ledges, split into energetic baby tumbleweeds, and drop useful desert flora for thirsty explorers!

## Gameplay & Highlights

- **Bouncing & Rolling Across the Dunes**: Swept along by desert winds with authentic, bouncy locomotion. Instead of sliding flat across the sand, tumbleweeds continuously hop, skip, and roll over sand ripples, kicking up little puffs of dust with every bounce. They easily hop over small rocks and low ledges, glance off canyon walls, and tumble naturally down steep dunes without getting stuck.
- **Interactive Desert Fun (Bat Them Around!)**: Walk up to a tumbleweed and give it a punch or swat it with a shovel! Tumbleweeds absorb your hits and launch sailing across the sands in the direction you strike them. Herd them into pens, clear them away from your campsite, or start an impromptu game of desert soccer with fellow explorers.
- **The Great Scatter: Baby Tumbleweeds!**: Cracking open a full-grown tumbleweed can hold an unexpected surprise: **one in three tumbleweeds will burst into four energetic baby tumbleweeds**! These miniature tumbleweeds instantly scatter in all directions, rolling and bouncing merrily across the dunes.
- **Desert Foraging & Survival Drops**: Surviving in sun-scorched wastelands is tough, but tumbleweeds can be a true lifesaver. As they roll across the plains, they sweep up and preserve regional plant life. Breaking a tumbleweed open yields sticks and native desert flora matching whichever biome you are currently exploring (such as dry shrubs, marram grass, or desert cacti). Striking them with tools yields higher harvests, with better tool materials providing even richer forage.
- **Natural Variety & Camouflage Disguises**: No two tumbleweeds look quite alike. They spawn in varying sizes, from tiny roadside bushes to giant rolling brambles. While most display classic sun-baked dried brush textures, rare tumbleweeds pick up the natural colors of the ground beneath them, blending seamlessly into red desert sand or pale white dunes.
- **Water Soluble**: Bone-dry and brittle, tumbleweeds are fundamentally allergic to water! If a strong gust blows one into an oasis, river, or coastal shore, it immediately dissolves in a soft poof of dust.
- **Seamless Biome Support**: Naturally populates classic deserts, sandstone canyons, and cold arid expanses out of the box, with automatic zero-configuration discovery for popular biome mods like Everness and community mapgens.
